Re-arming is cheap, and workers reuse their cached set-up, so a re-run skips the pickling, the region creation, and the worker-side set-up. A run collected with `collect="view"` hands its region to the view, so the next run stages a fresh one. Close with `close()` (or a with block) to release the shared memory. ::: ## Parameters {.doc-parameters} ::: {.doc-definition-items} [pool]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [pymizu.Pool]{.doc-parameter-annotation} : The [`Pool`](`pymizu.Pool`) to run on. The map is set up here; `seed` and `collect` are per-run options of [`PreparedMap.run()`](`pymizu.PreparedMap.run`) (mirroring mizu's `mizu_map_run()`). ::: ## Examples {.doc-examples} Set the map up once, then re-run it over replacement data at copy cost (same dtype and length swap in place): ::: {#977cd5bd .cell execution_count=1} ``` {.python .cell-code} import numpy as np import pymizu with pymizu.Pool.create(2) as pool: with pool.map_prepare(np.square, np.arange(4.0)) as pm: first = pm.run().collect(timeout=10) second = pm.run(np.array([4.0, -5.0, 6.0, 7.0])).collect( timeout=10 ) second ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display execution_count=1} ``` [np.float64(16.0), np.float64(25.0), np.float64(36.0), np.float64(49.0)] ``` ::: ::: ## Methods {.doc-methods} | Name | Description | |---|---| | [close()](#close){.doc-function .doc-label .doc-label-method} | Unlink the staged region (idempotent; return the run's map handle. ::: ::: {.doc-usage-source} Usage [Source](https://github.com/shikokuchuo/pymizu/blob/main/python/pymizu/_map.py#L2218-L2341){target="_blank" rel="noopener"} ::: ::: {.doc-signature .doc-function} ```pythonsignature run( x=None, *, seed=None, timeout=None, collect=None, ) ``` ::: #### Parameters {.doc-parameters} ::: {.doc-definition-items} [x]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [\_Any]{.doc-parameter-annotation} [=]{.doc-parameter-default-sep .op} [None]{.doc-parameter-default} : Replaces the staged data for this and later runs. When both the staged and the replacement x are arrays of the same dtype and length, the swap is an in-place copy — a loop that iterates over same-shaped data (optimizer steps, simulation sweeps) runs at copy cost, skipping the region creation and the worker-side set-up. Any other x is staged fresh on this run. [seed]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [int | bytes | bytearray | tuple[int | bytes | bytearray, int] | None]{.doc-parameter-annotation} [=]{.doc-parameter-default-sep .op} [None]{.doc-parameter-default} : Deterministic per-element seeding for this run, as for [`Pool.map()`](`pymizu.Pool.map`); ``None`` (the default) runs unseeded. The seed travels with the run's tasks, not the staged data, so reseeding a run is free — the repeated-simulation loop varies ``seed`` per run while the set-up is paid once. [timeout]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [float | None]{.doc-parameter-annotation} [=]{.doc-parameter-default-sep .op} [None]{.doc-parameter-default} : Seconds before the run's submission gives up; on expiry the tasks already in are cancelled and the TIMEOUT [`Sentinel`](`pymizu.Sentinel`) is returned (no handle). The collection deadline is the handle's `collect()`. [collect]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [str | None]{.doc-parameter-annotation} [=]{.doc-parameter-default-sep .op} [None]{.doc-parameter-default} : ``"copy"`` or ``"view"`` with ``template``; ``"list"`` without — as for [`Pool.map()`](`pymizu.Pool.map`). The choice is per run. ::: #### Returns {.doc-returns} ::: {.doc-definition-items} [ The run's map handle — collected exactly once, by]{.doc-parameter-annotation} : `collect()` (blocking) or `collect_async()` (event-driven). A run is a producer on the pool handle: a concurrent run or submit from a second thread raises `ConcurrentUseError`. A clean value collect keeps the set-up for the next run; a view collect hands the region to the view, and an interrupted run (timeout, an error, a worker death) drops it — the next run stages a fresh one either way. :::
